about: Domains whose links on the blog's /tidings/ page open the archived copy (archive.catallenya.com/view/) instead of the original: because they sit behind a (usually metered) paywall, or because the live page reads badly and the viewer's copy doesn't. Edit freely; the blog reads this at build time. A domain also covers its subdomains.
source: Started as a copy of https://github.com/MostlyEmre/hn-anti-paywall/blob/main/paywalls.json (2026-10-01); cut the same day to the paywalled sites among the blog's own links, checked live: newyorker.com and wired.com are metered, theverge.com is declared paywalled (isAccessibleForFree: false). Added 2026-10-01 for how the live page reads, checked at phone and desktop width: huffpost.com (collapsed ad slots leave 15+ blank gaps, and the link was an AMP page), theguardian.com (a full-screen consent wall locks the page), patrickcraig.co.uk (no mobile layout: a phone shows it at 40%), jacquescorbytuech.com (a footnote URL pushes the page sideways on a phone).
